description: Record the candidate's own answer to one or more of the six screening questions that repeat across job-application forms: which countries they are authorized to work in, whether they need visa sponsorship, their desired salary, their notice period, whether they are willing to relocate, and whether they are 18 or older. Call this the moment the candidate states one of these facts, so it is available to fill their next application form. Only pass fields the candidate actually stated — never guess or infer one. A field you leave out keeps whatever was already recorded; it is not cleared. To withdraw an answer — the candidate says it no longer holds, or they no longer want it given to employers — name it in clear; auto-apply then asks them instead of answering. privacy_consent is a permission, not a fact: set it only when the candidate says, in so many words, that they agree to employers' privacy and personal-data terms being accepted for them on every application.

age_18_or_older.description: Whether the candidate is 18 years of age or older.

authorized_countries.description: Countries the candidate is authorized to work in, as names or codes (e.g. "Germany", "US").

clear.description: Answers to withdraw back to unstated, by field name. Never name a field you also set.

desired_salary_amount.description: The candidate's stated desired salary figure.

desired_salary_currency.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency of the desired salary (e.g. "USD", "EUR").

desired_salary_period.description: The period the desired salary figure is stated over.

notice_period_days.description: How many days' notice the candidate must give their current employer.

privacy_consent.description: Whether the candidate agrees to the privacy / personal-data processing terms an employer's form requires being accepted for them. Ticks only that condition of applying — never a marketing, future-openings, SMS or diversity opt-in.

visa_sponsorship_needed.description: Whether the candidate needs an employer to sponsor a work visa.

willing_to_relocate.description: Whether the candidate is willing to relocate for a role.

name: screening_answers_set
title: Save screening answers
